issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'the great man among the Anakim' (הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים), referring to Arba as a great/important man among the Anakim, not 'a person of advanced age' (một người lớn tuổi). The Vietnamese rendering 'lớn tuổi' (old/elderly) changes the meaning from 'great/important' to 'old in age'.
